config.description: Metric threshold configuration, including a bounded query, comparison, and required Monitoring definition.

baseline_value.description: The value observed when the check was written, recorded on each result for context.

comparison.description: What the measured value must satisfy to pass.

bounds.description: The inclusive range for `between`; unused by `lte` and `gte`.

value.description: The bound for `lte` and `gte`; unused by `between`.

metric_id.description: Identifier of a metric on the report whose query this check measures. The metric's query is copied into `query` when the check is created.

metric_kind.description: How to draw this measurement; copied from a referenced metric.

monitoring.description: Monitoring definition for the replacement, including the target reference period and scaling policy.

baseline_period_minutes.description: The actual period measured by baseline_value, in minutes. Required when a baseline is supplied.

purpose.description: `expectation` evaluates whether the implementation met its target. `minimum_evidence` checks a fixed minimum sample count: meeting it passes the guard; missing it is inconclusive and requires assessment, never an implementation failure. Use a positive whole-number `gte` target on one unsampled raw count.

reference_period_minutes.description: The period the comparison target describes, in minutes. Independent of the soak and run schedule.

threshold_scaling.description: How the target applies to a measurement from Monitoring start to the observation time. `linear` multiplies the target by elapsed minutes / reference_period_minutes and requires an additive event count or property sum. `fixed` keeps the target unchanged, including for rates and averages. This definition does not enable Monitoring execution.

query.description: Live InsightVizNode wrapping one TrendsQuery: supplied by the caller, or copied from the named metric when the check is created. `dateRange.date_from` must be a relative window such as `-13d`, and `date_to` must be empty, so the check measures the days before each run rather than the days before it was written. The query must produce exactly one output series: use one event or action series, or combine up to ten of them with exactly one formula. Use no breakdown and no compare mode. A `trendsFilter.display` of `Metric` turns compare mode on, so `metricShowChange` is switched off for you unless `metricSummary` is `latest`, which keeps compare mode off already.

value_format.description: How to format measured values; copied from a referenced metric.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this Signal report check.

run_interval_minutes.description: Minutes between interim Monitoring measurements. Must be at least six hours and shorter than the observation window. Omit to use a quarter of the window, bounded to six hours through one day. Windows of six hours or less have no interim samples.

runs_remaining.description: Monitoring performs one terminal evaluation. Omit or set to 1; higher counts are not supported. Interim measurements do not consume this count.

soak_minutes.description: Observation window in minutes from Monitoring start. Omission preserves the existing window, including zero. Replacing a check during Monitoring restarts the period for all open checks.

title.description: Label for the new metric check.
